descriptions.en: Description In line with our vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been delivering solutions to the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative leader in ventilation devices, automated pipetting and sample storage, as well as the development of process sensors. The Business Unit Process Analytics develops, produces and distributes state-of-the-art process measurement technology for customers in biopharma, chemical and brewery industries. Our product portfolio includes sensors for critical process parameters such as pH, oxygen, or sensors for measuring cell density, which are extremely important in biological processes and are unique worldwide with their innovative technology. ## Job Responsibilities - Main tasks - Process-oriented implementation of quality requirements based on applicable standards, regulations and laws, as well as customer requirements - Preparation of risk assessments - Preparation, execution and follow-up of audits (internal audits, authority audits, customer audits) - Completion of general quality assurance tasks, e.g. processing quality assurance agreements with customers, evaluation of test plans, etc. - Creation and maintenance of quality documentation (internal guidelines, work instructions, etc.) in cooperation with the respective process owners - Evaluation and documentation of deviations and initiation, tracking and, where appropriate, taking over the management of the resulting measures - Collaboration in internal interdisciplinary committees - Conducting training courses in the field of quality for all technical departments (e.g. development, production, technical support, etc.) - Secondary tasks - Systematic support and partial technical management of expert teams in cause analyses, solution finding and effectiveness checks - Assistance to various departments in quality-related topics, e.g. compliance with ISO standards, country-specific approvals, etc. ## Requirements - Good understanding of customer and authority needs and transfer into processes and procedures - Initial work experience in quality assurance, quality management or similar environment, GxP experience is a plus - Scientific-technical or electrical engineering education/studies or comparable - Due to the international team, in addition to German, very good English language skills in writing and speaking (at least level B2) are required - Structured and methodical way of working and flexible, tolerant and factual dealing with external and internal contact persons - Skilled use of MS-Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint) - Initiative and communicative personality with hands-on mentality and customer-oriented solutions ## What we offer - Do you share our values and feel at home in a collegial and down-to-earth environment? - At Hamilton, we offer not only a motivating working environment, but also good opportunities for personal and professional development. ## Contact - Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch.

descriptions.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", the Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer when it comes to ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples, and the development of process sensors. The Process Analytics business unit develops, produces and sells state-of-the-art process measurement technology for customers in biopharma, chemicals and breweries. Our product portfolio includes sensors for critical process parameters such as pH value, oxygen, or sensors for measuring cell density, which are extremely important in biological processes and unique worldwide with their innovative technology. This is what you can achieve: Development of optical systems and definition of measurement principles Functional model and prototype creation Development of measurement algorithms and creation of analytical and statistical models based on experimental data as well as their visualization Simulation of physical phenomena in sensors such as optics, heat transfer, diffusion and flow Simulation and validation in laboratory and field tests Collaboration with internal and external knowledge carriers and know-how transfer in interdisciplinary projects Contribution of ideas for new products, technologies and research for potential external partners Management of technology projects with a focus on optics and data science What you bring with you: Completed studies in physics, photonics or the natural sciences, ideally with a doctorate and/or several years of professional experience in the field of sensor development Good theoretical knowledge and practical experience in physics, ideally with a focus on optics, optoelectronics or optical measurement technology Ready-to-use knowledge of optical simulations (e.g. Zemax), physical simulations (e.g. COMSOL) and signal processing desirable Model development with suitable tools/programming knowledge (Python, C/C++, MATLAB, R, etc.) are an advantage Hands-on mentality: skill and creativity in experimental work and experience in planning, setting up, carrying out and analyzing experiments Self-initiative, independent, structured and result-oriented way of working Good presentation and communication of technical issues Communicative and team-oriented personality Solid written and spoken German and English skills Find out more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch . Do you share our values ​​and do you feel at home in a collegial and down-to-earth environment? At Hamilton we not only offer a motivating working environment, but also various leisure activities and contemporary working conditions. The Business Unit Robotics develops, produces and distributes pipetting robots to automate Liquid Handling processes for the pharmaceutical, food, and cell or DNA research industries. ## Job Description You can achieve this: Technical Product Owner (TPO) – Product Lifecycle Engineering Your Mission You are the strategic and technical anchor for your product portfolio. You safely guide products through the entire lifecycle – from market introduction to EoL. You are not a lone fighter, but the central coordinator who networks experts and moderates collaboration within the team. Your Key Tasks - Overall technical responsibility - Risk Management: You proactively assess risks (technology, quality, costs). You make decisions not in isolation, but conduct technical reviews with the relevant departments to guarantee quality and manufacturability. - Coordination Delegation: You plan and prioritize all lifecycle activities (e.g., via WSJF). You keep an overview, but delegate operational tasks specifically to Lifecycle Engineers and support functions. - Team Interface Network: You maintain an intensive exchange with production, QM, Supply Chain, and Service. You are the "voice of the lifecycle" towards development and ensure that know-how flows between departments. - Project Impulses: You initiate cost-down or quality initiatives. You ensure that new products are only adopted when they have reached full series maturity (stable FPY, clean documentation) – you demand discipline here, but also offer full support during industrialization. - Active Change Management: You control technical changes in your portfolio. You decide when to take the lead yourself and when a project manager is better suited, but always advise the change team. ## • Requirements You bring this with you: - Technical foundation: studies in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar. - Experience: You know product development, industrialization, and lifecycle management from practice. - Team player mentality: You love coordination and technical leadership. descriptions.it: Descrizione Fedeli alla visione "Guidiamo l'innovazione per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton forniscono soluzioni per il settore sanitario dal 1950. Siamo pionieri innovativi quando si tratta di ventilatori, pipettaggio e conservazione automatizzati di campioni e sviluppo di sensori di processo. La business unit Process Analytics sviluppa, produce e vende tecnologie di misurazione di processo all'avanguardia per clienti del settore biofarmaceutico, chimico e dei birrifici. Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti comprende sensori per parametri di processo critici come valore pH, ossigeno o sensori per la misurazione della densità cellulare, che sono estremamente importanti nei processi biologici e unici al mondo con la loro tecnologia innovativa. ## Mansioni - Offriamo ai nostri clienti nell'industria biotecnologica, farmaceutica e di processo, nonché nella ricerca, soluzioni di misurazione innovative per i loro processi complessi, come la produzione di vaccini. - In qualità di sviluppatore, lavorerai all'interno del gruppo "Elettronica e firmware" nel nostro dipartimento di sviluppo. - Sarai coinvolto nello sviluppo e nella manutenzione di tecnologie di sensori innovative per la tecnologia di misurazione dei processi. - Lavori in team di progetto dinamici composti da specialisti di varie discipline, dove rappresenti il ​​settore dell'hardware elettronico. - I tuoi compiti principali includono: - Sviluppo di concetti elettronici - Sviluppo di hardware in team di progetto interdisciplinari - Schema e layout di hardware elettronico con software CAE - Creazione di concetti di test e specifiche di test - Creazione di piani di test EMC inclusa l'implementazione e la relativa documentazione - Costruzione, messa in servizio e test di prototipi e serie pilota - Partecipazione ad adattamenti hardware di prodotti esistenti - Creazione di documentazione completa ## Requisiti - Studi completati nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica Specializzazione in elettronica - Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo di prodotti industriali - Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel utilizzo di software CAE - Conoscenza della tecnologia dei circuiti analogici - Mise en œuvre autonome de la directive EKAS 6508, y compris un suivi continu, un développement ultérieur et la garantie de la conformité - Conseil indépendant aux dirigeants et aux collaborateurs sur toutes les questions de sécurité et de protection de la santé – vos compétences techniques sont activement sollicitées et intégrées aux processus décisionnels - Organisation, réalisation et suivi d'audits internes, d'inspections et de contrôles en matière de sécurité au travail – y compris la dérivation, la priorisation et le suivi des mesures d'amélioration - Rédaction d'analyses de risques et d'évaluations des dangers pour les postes de travail, les installations et les substances dangereuses, en tenant compte des exigences légales, réglementaires et internes actuelles - Développement continu et autonome de la norme de sécurité par le management systématique des mesures avec un focus clair sur la prévention et l'efficacité - Gestion, développement et garantie de la qualité de la documentation liée à la sécurité – structurée, traçable et conforme aux normes - La Hamilton Storage sviluppa, produce e distribuisce robot per la conservazione di fino a dieci milioni di sostanze chimiche per aziende farmaceutiche. Inoltre, produciamo robot per la conservazione di campioni biologici a -80°C, utilizzati in banche di campioni clinici per scopi di ricerca clinica. Questo è ciò che puoi fare: Come tecnico refrigerazione, sei responsabile di garantire che i sistemi di archiviazione Hamilton mantengano i prodotti dei clienti stabili nella fascia di temperatura da -80°C a + 30°C. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, sei responsabile di: Riparazioni e interventi di manutenzione presso i nostri clienti internazionali Pianificazione degli interventi di terze parti presso i nostri clienti Monitoraggio e valutazione dei lavori eseguiti dalle terze parti in base ai contratti e ai rapporti di lavoro Rinnovo dei contratti con le terze parti Monitoraggio e manutenzione del nostro magazzino di refrigeranti Creazione, monitoraggio e manutenzione dello stato delle nostre impianti di refrigerazione sul campo Responsabile della manutenzione dei nostri sistemi in base alle normative locali relative alla tecnologia del freddo Creazione e gestione di reclami dei clienti in software CSM Questo è ciò che porti con te: Inoltre, porti il tuo sapere tecnico e le tue esperienze acquisite sul campo nella divisione di sviluppo, in modo che i nostri prodotti diventino ancora migliori. Hai piacere nel trattare direttamente con i clienti. Hai una formazione come tecnico di sistemi di refrigerazione EFZ, inclusi i relativi certificati o la disponibilità a ottenerli per poter acquistare e trasportare refrigeranti. Sei certificato per l'uso di refrigeranti e hai già esperienza nel servizio di assistenza presso impianti di refrigerazione industriali. Non hai paura di affrontare sfide complesse, come la ricerca e la riparazione di perdite e guasti in aree difficilmente accessibili. Conosci le normative dei diversi paesi europei (ad esempio, la direttiva F-Gas UE n. 517/2014). Hai piacere nel viaggiare, ma lavori anche volentieri al nostro sede principale a Domat/Ems con colleghi di diverse discipline (ad esempio, servizio tecnico, ingegneria, produzione, gestione dei progetti). descriptions.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare sector since 1950. We are an innovative leader in the production of ventilators, automated pipetting and sample storage, as well as process sensor development. Hamilton Storage develops, produces and distributes robots for the storage of up to ten million chemical substances for pharmaceutical companies. Additionally, we produce robots for the storage of biological samples at -80°C, used in clinical research banks for clinical research purposes. This is what you can do: As a refrigeration technician, you are responsible for ensuring that Hamilton storage systems maintain customer products stable in the temperature range of -80°C to + 30°C. To achieve this, you are responsible for: Repair and maintenance interventions at our international customers Planning of third-party interventions at our customers Monitoring and evaluating the work performed by third parties based on contracts and work reports Renewing contracts with third parties Monitoring and maintaining our refrigerant storage Creating, monitoring and maintaining the status overview of our refrigeration systems in the field Responsible for the maintenance of our systems in accordance with local regulations regarding refrigeration technology Creating and processing customer complaints in CSM software This is what you bring with you: In addition, you bring your technical knowledge and experiences acquired on the job into the development department, so that our products become even better. You enjoy direct contact with customers. You have a training as a refrigeration system technician EFZ, including the relevant certificates or the willingness to obtain them in order to be able to purchase and transport refrigerants. You are certified for the use of refrigerants and have already gained experience in the service of assistance at industrial refrigeration plants. You are not afraid of complex challenges, such as searching and repairing leaks and defects in hard-to-reach areas. You are familiar with the regulations of the various European countries (e.g. EU Directive 517/2014 on F-Gases). You enjoy traveling, but you also work happily at our main office in Domat/Ems with colleagues from various disciplines (e.g. technical service, engineering, production, project management). You communicate clearly in German and English, as our team is multinational. You have a heavy goods vehicle driving license. Your workplace is in Graubünden (Domat/Ems). The position includes international travel up to 80% with a focus on Europe. Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton on jobs.hamilton.ch. Do you share our values and feel at home in a collegial and solid work environment? At Hamilton, we offer not only a motivating work environment, but also leisure offers and well-being solutions.

descriptions.en: ## Descrizione True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", the Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the health sector since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in the fields of ventilators, automated pipetting, sample management and in the development of process sensors. As part of the Shared Services (SHS) Business Unit at Hamilton Bonaduz AG, this area handles key functions for all Hamilton companies. Teams in HR, ICT, Corporate Communication, Facilities, and Finance ensure smooth processes and provide optimal support to employees worldwide. ## How you can make a difference The Group Team Leader GL Accounting is responsible for owning the integrity, accuracy, and efficiency of the general ledger and group consolidation processes for multiple Swiss and international entities. This role combines operational leadership with technical accounting expertise, including oversight of financial closings, group reporting, and statutory compliance. The position leads a team of accountants and plays a key role in driving continuous improvement in closing processes, systems, and controls, ensuring high-quality financial information aligned with both statutory and corporate requirements. ## Key Responsibilities - Lead and develop a team of GL accountants, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and fostering continuous professional development - Own and ensure high-quality execution of all general ledger activities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions, with a strong focus on accuracy, completeness, and timeliness - Take full responsibility for the monthly and annual closing processes, ensuring efficient, well-controlled, and timely execution across all entities - Manage and oversee the group consolidation process, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of consolidated financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards - Review and validate financial statements and consolidation outputs, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements and group accounting policies - Establish, monitor, and continuously enhance reconciliation and closing standards, ensuring discrepancies are identified and resolved proactively - Act as a key point of contact for internal and external audits, ensuring high-quality documentation, smooth audit processes, and timely resolution of audit findings - Collaborate closely with local accounting teams, tax, controlling, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and resolve complex accounting topics - Analyze financial data and consolidation results to identify risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implement sustainable solutions - Drive and lead initiatives to improve closing efficiency, automation, data quality, and internal controls, including active involvement in ERP and finance system enhancements ## That’s what you bring along - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field - 7+ years of progressive

descriptions.fr: Fidèle à la vision "Nous pouvons innover pour améliorer la vie des gens", les sociétés Hamilton ont fourni des solutions pour le secteur de la santé depuis 1950. Nous sommes un innovateur leader dans la production de ventilateurs, de pipettage automatisé et de stockage d'échantillons, ainsi que dans le développement de capteurs de processus. Hamilton Storage développe, produit et distribue des robots pour le stockage de jusqu'à dix millions de substances chimiques pour les entreprises pharmaceutiques. De plus, nous produisons des robots pour le stockage d'échantillons biologiques à -80°C, utilisés dans les banques d'échantillons cliniques pour des fins de recherche clinique. C'est ce que vous pouvez faire : En tant que technicien de réfrigération, vous êtes responsable de garantir que les systèmes de stockage Hamilton maintiennent les produits des clients stables dans la gamme de température de -80°C à + 30°C. Pour atteindre cet objectif, vous êtes responsable de : Réparation et interventions de maintenance auprès de nos clients internationaux Planification des interventions de tiers auprès de nos clients Suivi et évaluation des travaux effectués par les tiers en fonction des contrats et des rapports de travail Renouvellement des contrats avec les tiers Suivi et maintenance de notre stockage de réfrigérants Création, suivi et maintenance de l'état de nos systèmes de réfrigération sur le terrain Responsable de la maintenance de nos systèmes en fonction des réglementations locales relatives à la technologie du froid Création et traitement des réclamations des clients dans le logiciel CSM C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous : En outre, vous apportez votre connaissance technique et vos expériences acquises sur le terrain dans la division de développement, de sorte que nos produits deviennent encore meilleurs. Vous appréciez le contact direct avec les clients. Vous avez une formation en tant que technicien de systèmes de réfrigération EFZ, y compris les certificats pertinents ou la volonté de les obtenir pour pouvoir acheter et transporter des réfrigérants. Vous êtes certifié pour l'utilisation des réfrigérants et avez déjà acquis de l'expérience dans le service d'assistance auprès d'usines de réfrigération industrielles. Vous n'avez pas peur des défis complexes, tels que la recherche et la réparation de fuites et de défauts dans des zones difficiles à atteindre. Vous êtes familiarisé avec les réglementations des différents pays européens (par exemple, la directive F-Gas UE n. 517/2014). Vous appréciez le voyage, mais vous travaillez également volontiers à notre siège principal à Domat/Ems avec des collègues de diverses disciplines (par exemple, service technique, ingénierie, production, gestion de projets). Vous communiquez clairement en allemand et en anglais, car notre équipe est multinationale. Vous avez un permis de conduire pour les véhicules lourds. Votre lieu de travail est en Grisons (Domat/Ems). La position comprend un voyage international jusqu'à 80% avec un focus sur l'Europe. Chez Hamilton, nous offrons non seulement un environnement de travail motivant, mais également des offres de loisirs et des solutions de bien-être.

descriptions.fr: Fidèle à la vision « Nous réalisons l'innovation pour améliorer la vie des gens », les entreprises de Hamilton fournissent des solutions à l'industrie de la santé depuis 1950. Nous sommes un pionnier innovant en matière de ventilation, de pipetage automatisé et de stockage des échantillons et de développement de capteurs de processus. La Business Unit Robotics développe, produit et distribue des robots de pipetage pour automatiser les processus de manipulation des liquides pour les industries pharmaceutiques et alimentaires jusqu'à la recherche sur les cellules ou l'ADN. Vous pouvez faire cela : Propriétaire du produit technique (TPO) – Ingénierie du cycle de vie du produit Votre mission Vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille de produits défini dans le cycle de vie et assurez son support technique professionnel tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Dans l'environnement OEM, votre objectif est de soutenir les produits d'un client renommé dans les diagnostics. Déjà dans les projets de développement et d'innovation, vous apportez la perspective du cycle de vie et accompagnez les produits jusqu'au transfert propre dans le cycle de vie série. Ensuite vous contrôlez leur support technique jusqu'à la fin de la vie. Vous coordonnez les départements concernés, fixez des priorités claires et vous assurez que les sujets techniques sont traités de manière structurée, contraignante et avec le bon sens de la qualité, des risques et des exigences des clients. Vos tâches principales Soutien au cycle de vie: Soutien technique du portefeuille, y compris évaluation des risques techniques, qualitatifs et économiques. Initiatives relatives au cycle de vie et gestion du changement: lancement et soutien de mesures dans les domaines de la qualité, de la réduction des coûts et de la fin de vie ainsi que de la responsabilité technique dans le processus de changement. - Plaintes des clients : Traitement technique des composants des clients et des problèmes qui les concernent en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse structurée, l'urgence appropriée et les solutions durables. Assurer la maturité des séries: introduire les exigences du cycle de vie dans le développement et la coordination d'un transfert de produit propre dans le cycle de vie. Planification et hiérarchisation : structuration des ensembles de tâches, planification des activités dans votre propre portefeuille ainsi que délégation ciblée et gestion des tâches aux ingénieurs du cycle de vie et fonctions de soutien. Coopération interdisciplinaire: Personne de contact centrale pour le développement, la production, la qualité, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et le service. Gestion des intervenants: Communication professionnelle de contenu technique en anglais dans l'environnement OEM avec focalisation diagnostique. C'est ce que vous apportez : Votre profil - Fondement technique: Vous avez un diplôme en génie mécanique, en génie électrique, mécatronique ou une formation technique comparable. Expérience pertinente: Vous apportez une expérience pratique dans le développement de produits, la gestion du cycle de vie ou la gestion du changement. - Force de coordination : Vous aimez travailler aux interfaces, fixer des priorités claires et comprendre comment prendre des responsabilités sans tout vous-même

Das kannst du bewirken :
We are seeking a motivated and skilled Software Engineer with a strong focus on Python development to join our software team. The ideal candidate brings solid engineering fundamentals, hands- on development experience, and a structured, quality- oriented mindset.

This role contributes to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable software solutions that support critical business processes and expanding product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions primarily using Python

- Apply sound software engineering principles , including modular design, clean code practices, and maintainable architecture

- Contribute to system design discussions and technical decision- making

- Implement and improve automated testing ( unit, integration, system- level)

- Support lifecycle management of existing software components

- Collaborate closely with cross- functional teams including hardware, system engineering, and product stakeholders

- Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to improving development standards

- Support documentation, version control, and CI/ CD practices

Nice to Have

- Experience with frontend development using Angular or React

- Knowledge of UI/ UX integration principles

- Experience with containerization technologies ( e. g., Docker)

- Familiarity with CI/ CD pipelines

- Exposure to embedded, hardware- related, or system- level software environments

Desired Profile
The ideal candidate demonstrates strong analytical and problem- solving skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges in a structured and solution- oriented manner. A quality- focused mindset and disciplined working style are essential to ensure maintainable, reliable, and scalable software solutions.
The role requires someone who can work independently and take ownership of tasks while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. A proactive attitude, combined with clear communication skills, enables successful interaction across disciplines and supports efficient coordination with stakeholders from different technical and business domains.

Das bringst du mit :
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience

- 3- 5 years of professional software development experience Strong proficiency in modern pr

Getreu der Vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives" liefern die Hamilton Unternehmen seit 1950 Lösungen für die Gesundheitsbranche. Wir sind ein innovativer Vorreiter was Beatmungsgeräte, das automatisierte Pipettieren und Lagern von Proben sowie die Entwicklung von Prozesssensoren anbelangt.

Die Business Unit Process Analytics entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt modernste Prozessmesstechnik für Kunden in Biopharma, Chemie und Brauereien. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Sensoren für kritische Prozessparameter wie den pH-Wert, Sauerstoff, oder auch Sensoren zur Messung der Zelldichte, wie sie in biologischen Prozessen enorm wichtig und mit ihrer innovativen Technologie weltweit einzigartig sind.

Das kannst du bewirken :

- Interdisziplinäre Produktentwicklung (Mechanik, Elektronik, Physik, Chemie) an der Schnittstelle zum Produktmanagement und zur Produktion.

- Einbringen von kreativen Konstruktionsideen für einfache, kostengünstige und zuverlässige Lösungen

- Verantwortung für den mechanisch-konstruktiven Teil des Produktes von der Idee bis zur Serienreife (inkl. Aufbau und Test von Funktionsmustern und Prototypen)

- Durchführung und Beurteilung von technischen Berechnungen (z.B. Toleranzrechnungen)

- Erstellen von technischen Dokumenten während des Entwicklungsprozesses gemäss internen Richtlinien und Prozessen

- Enge Zusammenarbeit sowohl im Projektteam als auch mit externen Lieferanten und Kooperationspartnern

Das bringst du mit :

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau (FH/Uni)

- Fundierte CAD-Kenntnisse (vorzugsweise Creo Parametric)

- Selbständige, zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

descriptions.it:
Getreu der Vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives" liefern die Hamilton Unternehmen seit 1950 Lösungen für die Gesundheitsbranche. Wir sind ein innovativer Vorreiter was Beatmungsgeräte, das automatisierte Pipettieren und Lagern von Proben sowie die Entwicklung von Prozesssensoren anbelangt.

Die Business Unit Robotics entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt Pipettier-Roboter, um Liquid Handling Prozesse für die Pharma-, über die Nahrungsmittelindustrie bis hin zur Zell- oder DNA-Forschung zu automatisieren.

Das kannst du bewirken :
We are looking for a Senior AI Software Engineer / AI Solution Architect who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, especially in applying modern AI capabilities such as Large Language Models (LLMs) into real-world products.
This is a hands-on engineering role , not a purely conceptual or research-oriented position. The ideal candidate actively builds, experiments, and delivers production-ready software while contributing to the strategic adoption of AI across products and teams.

The role sits at the intersection of:

- Software engineering

- AI/ML application

- Product innovation

The candidate will play a key role in shaping how AI is integrated into current and future products and will contribute to internal AI capabilities, tooling, and best practices.

Das bringst du mit :

- Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or at a related field with focus on AI

- 5+ years of experience in software development and in working with AI / Machine Learning

- Technical skills in programming and Engineering (C#, Python or TypeScript, Java, Go)

- Practical experience with large language models (LLMs, AI APIs and integration)

- strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders

- Mentoring and coaching mindset

- Curiosity and continuous learning attitude

- English (C1) and as a plus German (B2) written and spoken

descriptions.it:
Fedele alla visione "Creiamo l'innovazione per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton forniscono soluzioni per l'industria sanitaria dal 1950. Siamo un pioniere innovativo in termini di ventilatori, pipettaggio automatizzato e stoccaggio di campioni e lo sviluppo di sensori di processo.

Il business unit Operations produce parti per tutte le aziende Hamilton da parti stampate a iniezione e punte pipette per la movimentazione liquida a parti metalliche e plastiche. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di produrre più parti possibile in-house. In questo modo, rimaniamo agili, indipendenti ed efficienti.

Può farlo?

- Responsabile dell'orientamento strategico del gruppo di prodotti Metals nell'ambiente industriale

- Sviluppare e attuare la strategia del gruppo di prodotti in linea con la strategia di approvvigionamento e operazioni

- Partecipazione a progetti di sviluppo e coordinamento delle attività di approvvigionamento all'interno degli appalti strategici

- Responsabile per la gestione professionale e globale dei fornitori (valutazione, selezione, valutazione e sviluppo)

- Condurre ricerca e monitoraggio mirati sul mercato degli appalti, nonché identificare nuove tendenze

- Creazione e negoziazione di contratti, conduzione dei negoziati sui prezzi e condizioni

- Garantire la disponibilità dei materiali nelle fasi di sviluppo in stretta collaborazione con gli acquirenti operativi

- Rispetto dei processi, della governance e della conformità

Questo è ciò che porti:

- Formazione commerciale o tecnica di base con un'ulteriore formazione commerciale completata

- Formazione completa nell'approvvigionamento o nella gestione della supply chain

- Diversi anni di esperienza nell'acquisto strategico nell'ambiente industriale

- L'esperienza con il gruppo di prodotti Metals è un vantaggio

- Personalità affidabile con il pensiero imprenditoriale

- Metodi di lavoro indipendenti, strutturati e coscienziosi

- Iniziativa, competenze di negoziazione e applicazione

- Giocatore di squadra aperto, comunicativo e integrità

- Negoziabile in tedesco e inglese, per parola e per iscritto (livello C1)

Scopri di più sulle opportunità di carriera a Hamilton a job.hamilton.ch.

Condividi i nostri valori e ti senti a casa in un ambiente collegiale e a terra? A Hamilton, non offriamo solo un ambiente di lavoro motivante, ma anche varie attività ricreative e condizioni di lavoro contemporanee. La nostra du-culture promuove la comunicazione aperta e la collaborazione piacevole. Diventa parte di un team in cui le tue competenze sono valutate e lo spazio è creato per idee innovative. Interessante? Per ulteriori domande, si prega di contattarci all'indirizzo job@hamilton.ch e fornire i seguenti dettagli:

descriptions.en:
True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

The Operations business unit produces parts for all Hamilton companies from injection moulded parts and pipette tips for liquid handling to metal and plastic parts. Our goal is to produce as many parts as possible in-house. In this way, we remain agile, independent and efficient.

You can do that :

- Responsible for the strategic orientation of the Metals product group in the industrial environment

- Develop and implement the product group strategy in line with the procurement and operations strategy

- Participation in development projects and coordination of procurement activities within strategic procurement

- Responsible for professional, global supplier management (evaluation, selection, assessment and development)

- Conduct targeted procurement market research and monitoring, as well as identifying new trends

- Creating and negotiating contracts, conducting price and conditions negotiations

- Ensuring material availability in the development phases in close cooperation with operational purchasers

- Compliance with processes, governance and compliance

This is what you bring :

- Basic commercial or technical training with further commercial education completed

- Completed training in procurement or supply chain management

- Several years of experience in strategic purchasing in the industrial environment

- Experience with the Metals product group is an advantage

- Reliable personality with entrepreneurial thinking

- Independent, structured and conscientious working methods

- Own initiative, negotiating skills and enforcement

- Open, communicative and integrity team player

- Negotiable in German and English, in word and writing (level C1)

Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch.

Do you share our values and feel at home in a collegial and down-to-earth environment? At Hamilton, we not only offer a motivating working environment, but also various leisure activities and contemporary working conditions. Our du-culture promotes open communication and pleasant cooperation. Become part of a team where your skills are valued and space is created for innovative ideas. Interested? For further questions, please contact us at jobs@hamilton.ch and provide us with the following details:
Reference: JR-5790-fjb/

Wir sind ein innovativer Vorreiter was Beatmungsgeräte, das automatisierte Pipettieren und Lagern von Proben sowie die Entwicklung von Prozesssensoren anbelangt.

Die Business Unit Operations produziert Teile für alle Hamilton Unternehmen von Spritzgussteilen über Pipettenspitzen fürs Liquid Handling bis hin zu Metall- und Kunststoffteilen. Unser Ziel ist es, möglichst viele Teile inhouse zu produzieren. So bleiben wir agil, unabhängig und effizient.

Das kannst du bewirken :

- Zusammen mit dem Gesamtprojektleiter und unseren internen Kunden bestimmst du die Anforderungen und erarbeitest eine strukturierte Systemanalyse

- Für die durch dich betreuten Projekte verantwortest du diese in Abstimmung innerhalb des CSV-Compliance-Teams

- Du stehst in regem Austausch mit unseren internen Kunden, um Abweichungen von den Definitionen zu beheben

Das bringst du mit :

- Ausgeprägtes Verantwortungs- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

- Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss, vorzugsweise in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering oder IT

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

- Berufserfahrung im Bereich Life Science, insbesondere im Umfeld von CSV-Aktivitäten (Computer System Validation)

- Weiterbildungen im Bereich Qualitätsmanagement, z. B. ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, IVDR oder MDR, sind von Vorteil

- Strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, Systeme zu analysieren und Anforderungen effizient sowie lösungsorientiert zu erarbeiten

Erfahre mehr über berufliche Möglichkeiten bei Hamilton unter jobs.hamilton.ch .

descriptions.it:
Fedele alla visione "Creiamo l'innovazione per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton forniscono soluzioni per l'industria sanitaria dal 1950. Siamo un pioniere innovativo in termini di ventilatori, pipettaggio automatizzato e stoccaggio di campioni e lo sviluppo di sensori di processo.

Il business unit Operations produce parti per tutte le aziende Hamilton da parti stampate ad iniezione a punte pipette per la movimentazione di liquidi in parti metalliche e plastiche. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di produrre più parti possibile in-house. In questo modo, rimaniamo agili, indipendenti ed efficienti.

Può farlo?

- Insieme al project manager globale e ai nostri clienti interni, si determinano i requisiti e si sviluppa un'analisi di sistema strutturata.

- Per i progetti da voi supervisionati, siete responsabili per loro in coordinamento all'interno del team di conformità CSV

- Siete in stretto contatto con i nostri clienti interni per risolvere deviazioni dalle definizioni

Questo è ciò che porti:

- Forte responsabilità e consapevolezza della qualità

- Università o laurea tecnica, preferibilmente in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccatronica o IT

- Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

- Esperienza professionale nel campo della scienza della vita, in particolare nel campo delle attività CSV (Computer System Validation)

- Un'ulteriore formazione nel campo della gestione della qualità, ad esempio ISO 13485, 21 CFR Parte 820, IVDR o MDR, sono vantaggiose

- Metodi di lavoro strutturati e pragmatici, nonché la capacità di analizzare i sistemi e sviluppare i requisiti in modo efficiente e orientato alla soluzione

Scopri di più sulle opportunità di carriera a Hamilton a job.hamilton.ch.

A Hamilton, non solo offriamo un ambiente di lavoro motivante, ma anche varie attività ricreative e condizioni di lavoro contemporanee. La nostra cultura promuove la comunicazione aperta e la piacevole collaborazione. Diventa parte di un team in cui le tue competenze sono valutate e lo spazio è creato per idee innovative. descriptions.en:
True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

The Operations business unit produces parts for all Hamilton companies from injection moulded parts to pipette tips for liquid handling to metal and plastic parts. Our goal is to produce as many parts as possible in-house. In this way, we remain agile, independent and efficient.

You can do that :

- Together with the overall project manager and our internal customers, you determine the requirements and develop a structured system analysis.

- For the projects you supervise, you are responsible for them in coordination within the CSV compliance team

- You are in close contact with our internal customers to resolve deviations from the definitions

This is what you bring :

- Strong responsibility and quality awareness

- University or technical college degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or IT

- Very good knowledge of German and English

- Professional experience in the field of life science, in particular in the field of CSV (Computer System Validation) activities

- Further education in the field of quality management, e.g. ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, IVDR or MDR, are advantageous

- Structured and pragmatic working methods as well as the ability to analyze systems and develop requirements efficiently and solution-oriented

Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch.

Do you share our values and feel at home in a collegial and down-to-earth environment? At Hamilton, we not only offer a motivating working environment, but also various leisure activities and contemporary working conditions. Our du culture promotes open communication and pleasant cooperation. Become part of a team where your skills are valued and space is created for innovative ideas. Interested? descriptions.fr:
Fidèle à la vision « Nous aidons l'innovation à améliorer la vie des gens », les entreprises de Hamilton offrent des solutions à l'industrie de la santé depuis 1950. Nous sommes un pionnier innovant en matière de ventilation, de pipetage automatisé et de stockage des échantillons et de développement de capteurs de processus.

L'unité des opérations produit des pièces pour toutes les entreprises de Hamilton, des pièces moulées par injection aux tuyaux pour la manutention des liquides aux pièces métalliques et plastiques. Notre objectif est de produire le plus de pièces possibles en interne. De cette façon, nous restons agiles, indépendants et efficaces.

Vous pouvez le faire :

- Avec le gestionnaire de projet et nos clients internes, vous déterminez les exigences et développez une analyse structurée du système.

- Pour les projets que vous supervisez, vous êtes responsable de leur coordination au sein de l'équipe de conformité CSV

- Vous êtes en contact étroit avec nos clients internes pour résoudre les écarts par rapport aux définitions

Voici ce que vous apportez :

- Forte responsabilité et sensibilisation à la qualité

- Diplôme universitaire ou technique, de préférence en génie mécanique, génie électrique, génie mécatronique ou informatique

- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais

- Expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des sciences de la vie, en particulier dans le domaine des activités CSV (Validation du système informatique)

- La formation continue dans le domaine de la gestion de la qualité, par exemple ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, IVDR ou MDR, est avantageuse

- Méthodes de travail structurées et pragmatiques ainsi que la capacité d'analyser les systèmes et de développer les besoins de manière efficace et axée sur les solutions

En savoir plus sur les possibilités de carrière à Hamilton à jobs.hamilton.ch.

Nous sommes un pionnier innovant en matière de ventilation, de pipetage automatisé et de stockage des échantillons et de développement de capteurs de processus.

L'unité des opérations produit des pièces pour toutes les entreprises de Hamilton, des pièces moulées par injection aux tuyaux pour la manutention des liquides aux pièces métalliques et plastiques. Notre objectif est de produire le plus de pièces possibles en interne. De cette façon, nous restons agiles, indépendants et efficaces.

Vous pouvez le faire :

- Coresponsabilité pour le leadership et l'expansion de la division Développement durable à Hamilton

- Appuyer la conception stratégique de l'orientation de développement durable de Hamilton et l'élaboration d'objectifs internes de développement durable

- La planification, la mise en oeuvre et le contrôle indépendants des projets de durabilité pour ancrer l'orientation sur la durabilité à Hamilton

- Promouvoir la stratégie de réduction du CO2 conformément à l'Initiative des objectifs scientifiques et en surveiller en permanence la réalisation

- Participation à la maintenance du système de management environnemental selon la norme ISO 14001 ; Personne-ressource pour les audits

- Partenaires Sparrings et soutien aux entreprises de Hamilton sur les questions de durabilité

- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des systèmes et des indicateurs de suivi et d ' établissement de rapports pour les rapports et la communication sur la durabilité

- Participation à l'évaluation annuelle de la durabilité EcoVadis

Voici ce que vous apportez :

- Études réalisées dans les domaines de la gestion durable, des sciences de l'environnement, de la gestion environnementale ou de la formation correspondante dans ces domaines

- Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la durabilité dans une fonction similaire

- Enthousiasme pour la durabilité et la compréhension stratégique

- Capacité d'analyser des questions complexes, de les concevoir conformément aux exigences de durabilité et d'expliquer les résultats en fonction des groupes cibles

- Compétences organisationnelles et expérience en gestion de projet, y compris Documentation

- Un haut sens des responsabilités et une grande résilience

- Excellente connaissance écrite et orale de l'anglais et de l'allemand (niveau C1/C2)

- Esperienza con requisiti normativi (ad es. Direttiva Macchine)

True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

The Robotics Business Unit develops, produces and distributes pipetting robots to automate liquid handling processes for pharmaceutical and food industries up to cell or DNA research.

You can do that :

- Electrical design of complete installations, installation, cabling and commissioning

- Drawing of electrical diagrams and definition of the necessary components

- Feasibility assessment and development of automation solutions

- Development and design of module tests

- Design of sensors and actuators

- Optimization and further development of internal tools

- Testing requirements in collaboration with project management

- Answer support requests from the field

This is what you bring :

- Training as an automatic, electrical or related discipline

- Further training as a technician HF is advantageous

- Experience in the field of robotics, automation and laboratory automation is advantageous

- Experience with regulatory requirements (e.g. Machinery Directive)

- Creative and communicative personality

- Enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams

- Good knowledge of English (verbal and written) in an international environment

- Willingness to travel on business (about 5-10% per year)

Può farlo?
Formare il futuro dei nostri servizi HR con noi
Siete pronti a prendere la responsabilità e prendere i nostri servizi HR al livello successivo insieme al vostro team? Siete entusiasti di processi efficienti, moderni sistemi HR e un servizio eccellente? Allora non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti.

Come Team Lead HR Services, si assume la responsabilità per i nostri sistemi di amministrazione HR e HR. Insieme al vostro team, assicuratevi che i nostri servizi HR siano efficienti, orientati al cliente e orientati al futuro. Allo stesso tempo, si promuove attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri processi, sistemi e servizi.

I vostri compiti:

- Condurrai e svilupperai un team di sette dipendenti nelle aree di HR Administration e HR Systems

- Sei responsabile della continua ottimizzazione, standardizzazione e digitalizzazione dei nostri processi e servizi HR

- Continuerai a sviluppare il nostro panorama del sistema HR insieme agli stakeholder interni e ti assicurerai che sistemi e processi siano integrati in modo ottimale

- Condurre progetti per l'ammodernamento e l'automazione dei servizi HR e contribuire attivamente a nuove idee

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con HR Business Partners, Payroll, IT e le nostre aree di business e considerarsi come una persona di contatto competente per tutti gli argomenti relativi ai Servizi HR

- Come pratico formatore, sei responsabile della formazione del nostro CV

- Promuovi l'ulteriore sviluppo del tuo team e crei un ambiente in cui la cooperazione, la responsabilità personale e il miglioramento continuo sono vissuti.

- Diversi anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione HR e conoscenza approfondita dell'intero ciclo di vita dei dipendenti

True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

As part of the Shared Services (SHS) business unit of Hamilton AG, this area assumes central tasks for the Hamilton companies. Teams in HR, ICT, Corporate Communication, Facilities and Finance ensure that processes run smoothly and that employees worldwide are optimally supported.

You can do that :
Shape the future of our HR services with us
Are you ready to take responsibility and take our HR services to the next level together with your team? Are you excited about efficient processes, modern HR systems and excellent service? Then we look forward to meeting you.

As Team Lead HR Services, you take responsibility for our HR administration and HR systems. Together with your team, you ensure that our HR services are efficient, customer-oriented and future-oriented. At the same time, you actively promote the further development of our processes, systems and services.

Your tasks:

- You will lead and develop a team of seven employees in the areas of HR Administration and HR Systems

- You provide a professional, efficient and service-oriented HR administration along the entire employee lifecycle – from entry to exit

- You are responsible for the continuous optimization, standardization and digitalization of our HR processes and services

- You will continue to develop our HR system landscape together with internal stakeholders and ensure that systems and processes are optimally integrated

- You lead projects for the modernization and automation of HR services and actively contribute new ideas

- You work closely with HR Business Partners, Payroll, IT and our business areas and see yourself as a competent contact person for all topics related to HR Services

- As a practical trainer, you are responsible for the training of our CV learner

- You promote the further development of your team and create an environment in which cooperation, personal responsibility and continuous improvement are lived.

This is what you bring :

- Several years of experience in HR administration and in-depth knowledge of the entire employee lifecycle

- Experience in leading teams or managing cross-divisional HR projects

- Completed studies with a focus on human resources, business administration or a related field or an equivalent qualification with corresponding professional experience

- Demonstrable experience in the optimization, digitization or modernization of HR processes

- A high affinity for HR systems and enjoyment of processes ef

descriptions.de:
Getreu der Vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives" liefern die Hamilton Unternehmen seit 1950 Lösungen für die Gesundheitsbranche. Wir sind ein innovativer Vorreiter was Beatmungsgeräte, das automatisierte Pipettieren und Lagern von Proben sowie die Entwicklung von Prozesssensoren anbelangt.

Die Business Unit Process Analytics entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt modernste Prozessmesstechnik für Kunden in Biopharma, Chemie und Brauereien. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Sensoren für kritische Prozessparameter wie den pH-Wert, Sauerstoff, oder auch Sensoren zur Messung der Zelldichte, wie sie in biologischen Prozessen enorm wichtig und mit ihrer innovativen Technologie weltweit einzigartig sind.

Das kannst du bewirken :
Ein hohes Qualitätsniveau ist nicht nur eine zentrale Anforderung unserer stark regulierten Kunden, sondern auch unser eigener Anspruch. Um eine ausgezeichnete Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, suchen wir für unsere Abteilung Customer Support eine engagierte Fachkraft im Bereich Administration und Kundenbetreuung.

Kundenbetreuung und Koordination

- Sicherstellen einer reibungslosen Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden sowie mit internen Ansprechpartnern

- Koordinieren und Bearbeiten von Kundenanliegen, beispielsweise Produktanfragen oder Beanstandungen

- Verantworten und Nachverfolgen der damit verbundenen administrativen Schritte

- Sicherstellen einer zuverlässigen und termingerechten Bearbeitung der Kundenanliegen
​
Daten- und Prozessmanagement

- Pflegen und Bearbeiten von Stamm- und Kundendaten

- Überwachen der Einhaltung definierter Prozesse innerhalb der Abteilung und an relevanten Schnittstellen

- Sicherstellen einer vollständigen, konsistenten und qualitativ hochwertigen Datenpflege
​
Weitere Aufgaben

- Koordinieren des Ersatzteilmanagements sowie von Warenrücksendungen innerhalb Europas und weltweit

- Unterstützen bei der Organisation von Kundenseminaren, internen Schulungen und Veranstaltungen

Du teilst dir diese Aufgaben mit einer weiteren Fachkraft und ihr stellt gemeinsam eine nahtlose Betreuung unserer Kunden sicher. Neben deiner direkten Kollegin steht dir ein erfahrenes Team aus technischen Fachpersonen zur Seite. Dieses unterstützt dich während der Einarbeitung und steht dir auch danach mit fachlichem Rat zur Verfügung.

Das bringst du mit :

- Develop people and future leaders through coaching, mentoring, and continuous skill development.

- Basic knowledge of Microsoft world from office tools to ERP and CSM solutions

La Robotics Business Unit sviluppa, produce e distribuisce robot di pipettaggio per automatizzare i processi di gestione del liquido per le industrie farmaceutiche e alimentari fino alla ricerca cellulare o del DNA.

Può farlo?

- Creare e mantenere le istruzioni di riparazione (valutare la storia tenendo conto di tutte le modifiche).

- Elaborazione di ordini di vendita preparati per quanto riguarda i costi di riparazione e la data di spedizione. Invio degli ordini al reparto spedizioni (OPD).

Questo è ciò che porti:

- Formazione come polimeccanico, meccanico, tecnico dell'elettronica che gode di compiti amministrativi o di formazione commerciale con un debole per le sfide tecniche

- La conoscenza del tedesco nella parola e nella scrittura è un prerequisito e una buona conoscenza dell'inglese

- Buona conoscenza dell'utente del PC

Siamo un pioniere innovativo in termini di ventilatori, pipettaggio automatizzato e stoccaggio di campioni e lo sviluppo di sensori di processo.

L'unità di business Process Analytics sviluppa, produce e distribuisce tecnologie di misura di processo all'avanguardia per i clienti in biofarmaci, prodotti chimici e birrifici. Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti comprende sensori per parametri di processo critici come pH, ossigeno o sensori per la misura della densità cellulare, che sono estremamente importanti nei processi biologici e sono unici in tutto il mondo con la loro tecnologia innovativa.

Può farlo?
Come chimico RnD / chimico di produzione, fai parte del nostro team di scienza RnD multidisciplinare, composto da fisici e chimici, responsabile per lo sviluppo di sensori elettrochimici e ottici, nonché per il trasferimento e la produzione di materiali sensoriali in produzione.

Compiti di un chimico di produzione (attività principali):

- Riproduzione di fluorophores su scala di produzione, conversione in una matrice polimerica pronta all'uso e loro lavorazione per la produzione di strati sensibili, in parte in una stanza pulita

- Attuazione dei controlli di qualità e di processo utilizzando metodi analitici appropriati

- Attuazione delle scale e ottimizzazione dei processi

- Documentazione del processo di produzione

- Controllo del processo e garanzia della disponibilità di consegna

- Collaborazione con il nostro reparto di produzione e il loro supporto nei problemi di processo

Compiti a ls RnD chemist (attività aggiuntive):

- Partecipazione a vari progetti di sviluppo

- Sviluppo e valutazione dei dati di analisi sperimentale

- Creazione di modelli funzionali e prototipi

- Collaborazione con fornitori di conoscenze interne ed esterne e trasferimento di know-how in progetti interdisciplinari

- Introduzione di idee per nuovi prodotti, tecnologie e ricerca per potenziali partner esterni

- Gestione dei progetti tecnologici

Questo è ciò che porti:

- Studi completi in Chimica / Chimica Polimerica o diversi anni di esperienza professionale come laboratorio chimico in Chimica sintetica

- Buona conoscenza teorica e esperienza pratica nel trasferimento da laboratorio a scala di produzione

- Idealmente, esperienza nello sviluppo di sensori chimici

- mentalità a mano: abilità e creatività nel lavoro sperimentale e nell'esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione e realizzazione di esperimenti

- Iniziativa propria, metodi di lavoro indipendenti, strutturati e orientati ai risultati

descriptions.en:
True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors.

The Process Analytics business unit develops, produces and distributes state-of-the-art process measurement technology for customers in biopharmaceuticals, chemicals and breweries. Our product portfolio includes sensors for critical process parameters such as pH, oxygen, or sensors for measuring cell density, which are extremely important in biological processes and are unique worldwide with their innovative technology.

You can do that :
As an RnD chemist / production chemist, you are part of our multidisciplinary RnD science team, consisting of physicists and chemists, responsible for the development of electrochemical and optical sensors as well as for the transfer and production of sensory materials into production.

Tasks a ls production chemist (main activities):

- Reproduction of fluorophores on a production scale, conversion thereof into a ready-to-use polymer matrix and processing thereof for the production of sensitive layers, partly in a clean room

- Implementation of in-process and quality controls using appropriate analytical methods

- Implementation of scale-ups and process optimization

- Production process documentation

- Process control and ensuring delivery readiness

- Collaboration with our production department and their support in process issues

Tasks a ls RnD chemist (additional activities):

- Participation in various development projects

- Development and evaluation of experimental analysis data

- Creation of functional patterns and prototypes

- Collaboration with internal and external knowledge providers and know-how transfer in interdisciplinary projects

- Introducing ideas for new products, technologies and research for potential external partners

- Management of technology projects

This is what you bring :

- Completed studies in Chemistry/Polymer Chemistry or several years of professional experience as a chemical laboratory in Synthetic Chemistry

- Good theoretical knowledge and practical experience in the transfer from laboratory to production scale-up

- Ideally, experience in the development of chemical sensors

- Hands-on mentality: skill and creativity in experimental work and experience in planning, building and conducting experiments

- Own initiative, independent, structured and results-oriented working methods

- Good presentation and communication of technical issues

- Communicative, team-oriented and reliable personality

- Solid knowledge of German and English in word and writing

descriptions.it: Fedele alla visione "Innoviamo per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton offrono da 1950 soluzioni per il settore sanitario. Siamo un innovatore leader nella produzione di macchine per la respirazione, l'automazione del pipettamento e la conservazione di campioni, nonché nello sviluppo di sensori di processo. La Hamilton Storage sviluppa, produce e distribuisce robot per la conservazione di fino a dieci milioni di sostanze chimiche per aziende farmaceutiche. Inoltre, produciamo robot per la conservazione di campioni biologici a -80°C, utilizzati in banche di campioni clinici per scopi di ricerca clinica. Questo è ciò che puoi fare: Come tecnico refrigerazione, sei responsabile di garantire che i sistemi di archiviazione Hamilton mantengano i prodotti dei clienti stabili nella fascia di temperatura da -80°C a + 30°C. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, sei responsabile di: Riparazioni e interventi di manutenzione presso i nostri clienti internazionali Pianificazione degli interventi di terze parti presso i nostri clienti Monitoraggio e valutazione dei lavori eseguiti dalle terze parti in base ai contratti e ai rapporti di lavoro Rinnovo dei contratti con le terze parti Monitoraggio e manutenzione del nostro magazzino di refrigeranti Creazione, monitoraggio e manutenzione dello stato delle nostre impianti di refrigerazione sul campo Responsabile della manutenzione dei nostri sistemi in base alle normative locali relative alla tecnologia del freddo Creazione e gestione di reclami dei clienti in software CSM Questo è ciò che porti con te: Inoltre, porti il tuo sapere tecnico e le tue esperienze acquisite sul campo nella divisione di sviluppo, in modo che i nostri prodotti diventino ancora migliori. Hai piacere nel trattare direttamente con i clienti. Hai una formazione come tecnico di sistemi di refrigerazione EFZ, inclusi i relativi certificati o la disponibilità a ottenerli per poter acquistare e trasportare refrigeranti. Sei certificato per l'uso di refrigeranti e hai già esperienza nel servizio di assistenza presso impianti di refrigerazione industriali. Non hai paura di affrontare sfide complesse, come la ricerca e la riparazione di perdite e guasti in aree difficilmente accessibili. Conosci le normative dei diversi paesi europei (ad esempio, la direttiva F-Gas UE n. 517/2014). Hai piacere nel viaggiare, ma lavori anche volentieri al nostro sede principale a Domat/Ems con colleghi di diverse discipline (ad esempio, servizio tecnico, ingegneria, produzione, gestione dei progetti). Comunici in modo chiaro in italiano e inglese, poiché il nostro team è multinazionale. Hai un permesso di guida per veicoli pesanti. Il tuo luogo di lavoro è in Grigioni (Domat/Ems). La posizione prevede un'attività di viaggio internazionale fino al 80% con focus in Europa. Scopri di più sulle opportunità di carriera presso Hamilton su jobs.hamilton.ch. Condividi i nostri valori e ti senti a tuo agio in un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e solido? Presso Hamilton offriamo non solo un ambiente di lavoro motivante, ma anche offerte di tempo libero e soluzioni di benessere.
descriptions.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare sector since 1950. We are an innovative leader in the production of ventilators, automated pipetting and sample storage, as well as process sensor development. Hamilton Storage develops, produces and distributes robots for the storage of up to ten million chemical substances for pharmaceutical companies. Additionally, we produce robots for the storage of biological samples at -80°C, used in clinical research banks for clinical research purposes. This is what you can do: As a refrigeration technician, you are responsible for ensuring that Hamilton storage systems maintain customer products stable in the temperature range of -80°C to + 30°C. To achieve this, you are responsible for: Repair and maintenance interventions at our international customers Planning of third-party interventions at our customers Monitoring and evaluating the work performed by third parties based on contracts and work reports Renewing contracts with third parties Monitoring and maintaining our refrigerant storage Creating, monitoring and maintaining the status overview of our refrigeration systems in the field Responsible for the maintenance of our systems in accordance with local regulations regarding refrigeration technology Creating and processing customer complaints in CSM software This is what you bring with you: In addition, you bring your technical knowledge and experiences acquired on the job into the development department, so that our products become even better. You enjoy direct contact with customers. You have a training as a refrigeration system technician EFZ, including the relevant certificates or the willingness to obtain them in order to be able to purchase and transport refrigerants. You are certified for the use of refrigerants and have already gained experience in the service of assistance at industrial refrigeration plants. You are not afraid of complex challenges, such as searching and repairing leaks and defects in hard-to-reach areas. You are familiar with the regulations of the various European countries (e.g. EU Directive 517/2014 on F-Gases). You enjoy traveling, but you also work happily at our main office in Domat/Ems with colleagues from various disciplines (e.g. technical service, engineering, production, project management). You communicate clearly in German and English, as our team is multinational. You have a heavy goods vehicle driving license. Your workplace is in Graubünden (Domat/Ems). The position includes international travel up to 80% with a focus on Europe. Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton on jobs.hamilton.ch. Do you share our values and feel at home in a collegial and solid work environment? At Hamilton, we offer not only a motivating work environment, but also leisure offers and well-being solutions.
